description: Refine a previous CielStay search in natural language, such as "more rustic", "closer to the park", "better views" or "bigger place". Takes the original query plus the refinement; no session or token is needed.

persona.description: Carry the same persona through from the original search, if you sent one.

previousIntent.description: The `currentIntent` object from the previous response, if you still have it. Preserves location and dates across the refinement. Optional — omit it and the refinement still works.

query.description: The original search query you want to refine, exactly as you sent it before.

refinement.description: Natural language refinement instruction. Examples: "more rustic and less modern", "closer to the water", "something with better views", "bigger — needs 3+ bedrooms".

name: refine_search
